create.title: Primitive-ray q-dispersion character and equal-capacity obstruction
create.statement_tex: In the residual canonical hard top M2 cone, primitive odd rays a=m-q, b=m+q satisfy m not congruent q mod 2, (m,q)=1, and chi_4(a)chi_4(b)=(-1)^q. At fixed m every legal q-shift is q to q+2h, so the character autocorrelation is +1 and parity-aware Poisson retains a zero frequency. At fixed a, sign-changing shifts give an exact complete-symbol Fejer Gram with both moving reciprocal intervals, lift sets, owner masks, entry/exit samples, and the joint metric density-discrepancy coefficient. With positive linear capacity P asymp L^2 sqrt(rho), row energy E_0 asymp L J D^2, and H<=D, separately estimating the diagonal and the shifted correlations costs P^2/H and gains at most D^(-1/2) linearly; it cannot supply rho^(-1/2) on the nonempty hard range rho>D, including q=1 nonsquare Pell rows with D asymp 1 and rho tending to infinity. Fourier transformation in the shift, parity-aware q-Poisson, and the adjoint reciprocal transform return to the original half-frequency or transposed two-character row at equal capacity. The full phase has a radial Hessian null direction. This is a scoped obstruction to automatic character, coefficientwise, diagonal-separated, determinant-only, and transform-unitarity proofs; it is not a lower bound for the complete actual block and does not exclude a new signed actual-Gram estimate.
create.next_action: Do not repeat fixed-m alternation, coefficientwise q-A-process, or parity-aware Poisson. Any successor must prove cancellation in the complete fixed-a shifted Gram or use an additional actual physical variable.

create.title: Complete fixed-a primitive-ray shifted Gram estimate
create.statement_tex: For every residual hard top M2 block, let F_a(q) be the exact zero-extended fixed-a row retaining the primitive and owner masks, moving k interval, finite odd lifts, profiles, floors, stars, physical entry/exit integral, and the coupled metric coefficient W_R. Let G_H^act=sum_(a,n)|sum_(0<=h<H)(-1)^h F_a(n+h)|^2, E_0 asymp L J D^2, and rho=A J D^3/L^3. Prove for some lawful 1<=H<=D that G_H^act <<_epsilon X^epsilon H^2 E_0/rho, or prove an equivalent direct complete nonzero-shift correlation estimate. The stationary determinant contains g'/(k'(a+2q+2s)^(3/2))-g/(k(a+2q)^(3/2)) and must be controlled jointly with all moving symbols and the metric density. Together with the accepted one-count assembly and logarithmic block sum, this would close the canonical residual hard top M2 density-discrepancy energy. The statement does not cover other M2 packets or all-denominator endpoint assembly.
create.next_action: Attack the determinant-weighted off-shift correlation before taking absolute values, with special attention to the short-q and near-equal g/k locus.

reject.reason: The exact primitive odd lattice has one q parity at fixed m, so legal shifts are q to q+2h and the character autocorrelation is identically +1.
A separately estimated zero shift contributes P^2/H with H<=D, giving at most D^(-1/2) linearly; q=1 nonsquare Pell rows have D asymp 1 and rho tending to infinity.
On the exact parity coset the dual lattice is one-half Z and contains zero; in the q-slice representation modulation only shifts the original row to frequency one half.
The complete three-variable phase is degree-one homogeneous with a radial null vector, and the saddle-reduced (m,q) Hessian has rank one.
That wedge is only compatible with the diagonal capacity. The complete signed off-shift Gram and its moving determinant locus remain unproved.
